Default.note: Previous / 1 2 3 / Next with page 2 outlined. Active state is the only box on the row, so the current page reads immediately.

FirstPage.note: Previous is muted and pointer-disabled at the start of the range; clearly inert without shouting.

PrevNextOnly.note: The calmest form: two controls plus a 'Page 2 of 7' meta line, centred.

BelowTheIndex.note: In-situ: ruled work index with years right-aligned, pagination centred below. Shows where the component actually lives.
